iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 47. RISING: Iran nuclear chief RULES OUT ANY restrictions on enrichment program (Apr 9). IAEA still unable to verify Isfahan tunnel complex status. 440kg 60% enriched uranium unaccounted for. Nuclear dismantlement was the key sticking point in collapsed Islamabad talks. JINSA report: Iran evicted IAEA inspectors from most sites. Fordow status unknown. Technical: CRITICAL. Diplomatic: LOW. Probability UP to 24%. Rising.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 47. CRITICAL ESCALATION: US Navy blockade of ALL Iranian ports ACTIVE as of today 10am ET. Iran threatens NO port in Gulf will be safe. Trump vows to kill Iranian warships. UK Starmer: NOT supporting blockade. France/UK convening Hormuz navigation mission. ASEAN urges ceasefire. Oil above $110. Pope Leo hits back at Trump over war. China expresses hope for ceasefire. Netanyah supports blockade. Dow futures -500. Rhetoric: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 58%. Rising sharply.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel–Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 47. ESCALATING: Israel EXTENDS ground operations in southern Lebanon. Israeli military says ops extended. Lebanese Red Cross offices in Tyre hit by drone. Still rejects ceasefire with Hezbollah. Washington talks next week. 1,500+ killed, 1M displaced. Hezbollah paused attacks but Israel continues. Pope Leo demands ceasefire. Probability UP to 33%. Rising.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan opens LARGEST defense production facilities in Turkish history - warhead, missile integration, fuel production. Air-launched ballistic missile tests planned 2026. Tayfun ballistic missile unveiled. FM Fidan warns arms race if Iran develops weapons. NATO missile interceptions of Iranian missiles over Turkish airspace. Technical: HIGH. Probability UP slightly to 15%. Stable.

india.name: India–Pakistan
india.notes: WATCH: CFR survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely in 2026 due to heightened terrorist activity. Drivers of conflict remain intact despite ceasefire after May 2025 crisis. Pakistan mediating Iran ceasefire simultaneously. Operation Sindoor aftermath tensions persist. Rhetoric: HIGH. Probability STABLE at 24%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 52. ESCALATING: Medvedev nuclear threats against Ukraine and suppliers continue. Russia openly reveling in Trump attacks on NATO. Iran war windfall: oil revenues surging billions, sanctions easing. NATO strained by US-European rift. New START expired Feb 2026. Russia shaping narrative ahead of 2026 NPT Review. Probability UP to 60%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: ESCALATING: Xi meets KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun, says China will ABSOLUTELY NOT TOLERATE Taiwan independence. Taiwan tracks worrying rise in Chinese naval activity even during peace talks. China reportedly planning to help Iran with air-defense weaponry (NBC). PLA Eastern Theater Type 055 destroyers completed live-fire drill. Taiwan reinforcing asymmetric defense. Technical: CRITICAL. Mobilization: CRITICAL. Probability UP to 26%. Rising.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 47. SUSTAINED TESTING: 3 consecutive days of major weapon tests (Apr 6-8). Cluster-bomb warhead ballistic missiles tested. Top diplomat repeats SK is most hostile enemy state. Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. Global distraction from Iran war gives NK cover. ICBM and tactical nukes deployed. Probability 85%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia–Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1150+. ESCALATING: Ukraine drone advantage stalling Russian advances - 115 mid-range strikes in March (up from 41 Jan). Russia regenerating tank force (Janes). Russia claims 1200+ Ukrainian losses in 24h. Iran war strategic windfall for Russia. Oil surging benefits Moscow. New START expired. Probability UP to 80%. Rising.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: ESCALATING: Pakistan declared OPEN WAR on Afghan Taliban regime. Fighting entered 5th day of active conflict. China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi ongoing. Mortars killing Afghan civilians including children. Worst conflict since Taliban returned to power 2021. Pakistan simultaneously mediating Iran ceasefire. Probability UP to 20%. Rising.
